data.reason: Formulates paints and coatings chemistry for automotive and aerospace; not a metal galvanizing service or electrical products business.
Makes paints and chemical coatings as products; AZZ applies metal (zinc) coatings as a fee-based service to customers' steel.

Both companies work on protective coatings for metal in industrial and infrastructure markets. AZZ is a toll-processing service provider. It applies hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating to customers' steel. PPG is a global manufacturer that sells paints and coatings as products. Its customers include automotive, aerospace, packaging, architectural and retail buyers, which AZZ does not serve. The overlap in offering and customers is partial, and the business models differ, so this is adjacent rather than direct.

P2.1.text: North America's Leading Metal Coatings Company - About AZZ

P2.2.text: Learn about AZZ, North America's leading metal coatings company, delivering galvanizing, coil coating, and advanced metal coating solutions.

P2.3.text: Industry-leading provider of metal coating solutions supporting everyday life

P2.4.text: AZZ Inc. is North America’s leading independent provider of hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating solutions serving a broad range of end markets. Collectively, our business segments provide sustainable, unmatched metal coating solutions that enhance the longevity and appearance of the buildings, products and infrastructure people rely on every day.

P2.5.text: Meeting the needs of diverse and evolving markets

P2.6.text: AZZ combines large-scale galvanizing operations, integrated coil coating capabilities, and advanced surface technologies to help customers improve corrosion protection, operational efficiency, product quality, and long-term performance. Backed by an extensive network of facilities and specialized coating technologies, AZZ helps customers access the solutions, capacity, and technical support needed to meet changing business demands.

P2.7.text: North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer of fabricated steel

P2.8.text: AZZ Galvanizing provides industry-leading corrosion protection solutions that help extend service life, reduce maintenance requirements, and improve lifecycle performance across critical infrastructure and fabricated steel applications. As North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer, AZZ combines scalable capacity, decades of galvanizing expertise, and a commitment to consistent quality and responsive customer support.

P2.9.text: North America’s leading independent provider of coil coating services

P2.10.text: AZZ Precoat Metals delivers coil coating and value-added processing solutions engineered to increase production efficiency, product durability, and appearance performance across thousands of applications. Strategically located facilities and integrated processing capabilities help customers improve supply chain efficiency, simplify production coordination, and respond to changing manufacturing demands.

P2.11.text: Advanced surface technologies and metal finishing solutions

P2.12.text: AZZ Surface Technologies provides advanced metal finishing systems and value-added coating services tailored to environmental, performance, and industry requirements. Through automated operations, integrated coating systems, and extensive finishing expertise, AZZ simplifies coating coordination, reduces supply chain complexity, and meets accelerated project schedules through a single experienced finishing partner.

P2.13.text: Built on expertise. Focused on the future.

P2.14.text: AZZ continues to invest in advanced manufacturing technologies, sustainability initiatives, operational efficiency, and workforce development that support responsible growth across its businesses.

P1.2.text: Discover how PPG’s global team of innovators drives sustainable solutions, enhances productivity, and celebrates 140 years of color leadership. Join us!

P1.3.text: PPG: We protect and beautify the world®

P1.4.text: The first-choice partner to meet customers’ evolving needs for innovative paints, coatings and surface solutions.

P1.5.text: In business for more than 140 years

P1.6.text: Our global teams work every day to develop and deliver the paints, coatings and specialty products that our customers have trusted for more than 140 years. Explore our businesses and the markets they serve.

P1.7.text: We've got you covered with industry-leading transparencies, coatings, sealants, engineered materials and services designed to maximize aircraft performance across the entire lifecycle.

P1.8.text: Delivering the right solution for every surface to create longer-lasting, more beautiful spaces through a global portfolio of leading paint and stain brands – driven by sustainable innovation, color expertise and modern digital tools.

P1.9.text: Combining our expertise in coatings and technologies to aid automakers around the world in enhancing the image and identity of their vehicle brands.

P1.10.text: When it comes to building durability, increasing performance or enhancing appearance, Our refinish business owns a track record of success no other company can match.

P1.11.text: Leading industrial manufacturers of the best-known products, landmarks and brands trust us to deliver the innovations and services that enhance and protect assets used every day.

P1.12.text: Our extensive range of metal packaging coatings are designed protect the quality of our favorite consumer goods from both inside and outside the can including food, beverages and personal care products.

P1.13.text: We’re developing coatings that help protect assets across industries, including infrastructure, oil and gas, power, renewables and marine vessels, in the world's most demanding environments.

P1.14.text: Partnering with customers to solve complex challenges, our advanced materials transform industries –enhancing vision and eye safety, safeguarding critical documents, enabling water reuse, and powering next-generation, energy-efficient OLED displays – improving everyday life worldwide.

P1.15.text: The broad portfolio of pavement markings and traffic safety solutions includes paint, thermoplastics and other advanced traffic technologies, which help keep motorists, cyclists, road workers and pedestrians safe in our communities.

P2.1.text: From pre-treatment to colorful topcoats, PPG Industrial Coatings delivers high-performance products across a range of technologies for a variety of industries.

P2.2.text: Our coatings are just the start. Choose PPG and you select one of the world’s most trusted brand of industrial coatings. But far more important, you enlist a partner in success – creating efficiencies that save you time and money providing products that satisfy your customers. That’s the Power of a Partner.

P2.3.text: The real plus is the total solution you get from a reliable partner.

P2.4.text: We invite you to explore PPG and learn why our commitment to your success goes beyond paints and coatings. Whether you are satisfied with your current coatings supplier or exploring new options, we encourage you to give us a try. We’re ready to earn your trust and demonstrate the difference that PPG’s Power of a Partnership can make in your business.
